Why Deliverado.

Turn a fragmented delivery process into one clear journey from restaurant to customer.

Today

  • Calling multiple people to find a rider
  • Unclear delivery pricing

The Deliverado approach

  • One connected delivery workflow

From order to doorstep.

Seven clear steps keep every person in the delivery informed.

Customer orders

The customer chooses a restaurant and places a food order.

Restaurant receives it

The order arrives with the details the kitchen needs.

Restaurant confirms

The restaurant accepts the order and begins preparing the food.

Rider is assigned

An available rider receives the delivery details.

Rider picks up

The rider collects the prepared order from the restaurant.

Customer tracks delivery

The customer follows the order as it moves to their door.

Delivery is completed

Proof of delivery confirms that the order arrived.

Built for how Uganda eats.

Deliverado is shaping a food delivery experience around the way people in Kampala find places, pay and stay informed.

Made for how Uganda moves and pays

Pay with MTN Mobile Money or Airtel Money. Find any address by searching a nearby landmark, dropping a pin, or adding a plot number.

Delivery visibility

Follow the order from pickup to confirmed delivery, with a clear view of each step along the way.

We're building before we launch

Onboarding restaurants, building the rider network, preparing the technology and listening to customers.

Launching close to home

Starting in Naalya and Kansanga, with more areas as we grow.
